faq.q: Does this information replace a medical consultation?
faq.a: No. Only a qualified surgeon, after an examination, can tell you whether a procedure suits your situation. Our pages help you prepare for that consultation.

faq.q: How many surgeons can I contact?
faq.a: You choose between 1 and 3 surgeons yourself. Your request is sent only to them.
By a fixed subscription from listed surgeons. No commission is taken on procedures or requests, and no ranking can be paid for.

The questionnaire is limited to closed questions, with no photos or free-text medical details, and needs your explicit consent. Requests are only stored with hosting in the European Union by a certified health-data host.
Yes. Their registration is checked against their country's official register before they are listed.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: [TO COMPLETE after the data protection impact assessment and appointment of the DPO.]
Data collected: planned procedure, closed medical questions, contact details. Legal basis: your explicit consent (UK GDPR Article 9(2)(a)).
Recipients: only the surgeons you select. Hosting: European Union.
Retention: 6 months after your request is sent. You can access, correct or delete your data or withdraw consent at any time, and complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO).

Audience measurement: Google Analytics 4, only after your consent (you can refuse or change your mind at any time via “Manage cookies”). Only public pages are measured; the request form never is. Advertising purposes are disabled.

methodology.title: How we work
body: Content: every guide follows an editorial charter that rules out any promise of results and requires a section on risks. It is reviewed by a named, qualified surgeon, with the review date shown.
Surgeon verification: we check every surgeon against the official register in their country, then again every year.
Ranking: surgeons are listed by specialty, location and languages spoken. No surgeon can pay to rank higher.
Funding: surgeons pay a fixed subscription, regardless of how many requests they receive. We take no commission on procedures.
